newsitem.title: USA: Security Capital sets ratio for Homestead.
newsitem.headline: Security Capital sets ratio for Homestead.

text.p: Security Capital Pacific Trust said on Wednesday that its shareholders will receive .122455 Homestead common shares and .082153 Homestead warrants per Security Capital share in the spin-off of Homestead Village Inc.
Shareholders will also receive cash for fractional shares and warrants, the company said.
Distribution will be on November 12 to common shareholders of record on October 29, the company said.

In addition, the company set an $18.611 per share conversion for its cumulative convertible Series A preferred shares, equivalent to a conversion rate of 1.3433 common shares for each cumulative convertible Series A preferred share. The conversion price had been $20.556, the company said.
